title: Polls
subtitle: Community polls and award ballots, and the awards seasons that group them.
notFound: That poll could not be found.

empty.polls: No polls yet. Create the first one.

resultsVisibility.after_announcement: Everyone, once the winners are announced

quorum.half: More than half of the players

tiePolicy.none: No team vote, recorded as no consensus

fields.title: Title
fields.subject: Who answers
fields.subjectHint: A team poll is answered by roster members and rolls up into one team answer.
fields.afterAnnouncementHint: Voting closing and the winners being announced are different moments. Set the announcement date on the awards season.
fields.opensHint: A poll with no opening time never takes answers, which is what keeps published results readable but unanswerable.
fields.quorumHint: Only players count. Coaches, managers and analysts are on the roster but not in the quorum.
fields.datesHint: All times are shown to each visitor in their own timezone. Leave a date blank if it is not decided yet.

switches.allowEditHint: On, somebody can come back and change their mind until the poll closes. Off, the first answer is final.
switches.anonymousHint: Nobody, including AFC admins, can see how somebody answered. This cannot be turned off once anybody has answered.
switches.anonymousLocked: People have already answered, so this can no longer be changed.
switches.anonymousEditableCaveat: Anonymous plus letting people change their answer means the site still has to find their answer again. No admin can see it, but it is not unlinkable in principle. Turn off editing for that.
switches.voterListHint: Usernames appear under each option. People answer differently when their name is attached, and this cannot be un-done once they have voted.
switches.voterListBlocked: Not available on an anonymous poll.
switches.captainOverride: Let the captain set the team's answer
switches.captainOverrideHint: Off by default. When used it is always visible to the roster, with the members' own counts beside it.
switches.showRollup: Show the team its running count
switches.showRollupHint: Off if seeing the running count would change how the rest of the roster answers.

questions.helpPlaceholder: A smaller line under the question (optional)
questions.optionImage: Picture address (optional), shown on the awards pages
questions.lockedHint: People have already answered this poll, so its questions cannot change. Editing them would silently change what those people were asked.

audience.everyoneHint: Leave this on for a community poll. Turn it off to narrow it down.
audience.seasonTiersHint: The team's or the player's tier on the Rankings page, from the latest season AFC has published. Tier 1 is the strongest. Frozen when the poll opens, so nobody is shown a ballot and refused later.
audience.teamRolesHint: Captain counts however the team records it.
audience.beforeTheyVoteHint: These do not narrow the audience. Somebody missing one is still invited, they just have to fill it in first, and they get a link that does it.
audience.noCount: Press count to see how many people this is.

branching.intro: Branching is a list of sentences. Each one watches one answer and shows or hides one question.
branching.watchable: Only pick-one, pick-several and rating questions can be watched. Free text is not something a rule can read reliably.

results.anonymousNote: This poll is anonymous, so the per-question breakdowns are not available. The link between a person and their answer is not stored.

metrics.intro: Detailed numbers for every awards season, including seasons that are over. Nothing here depends on whether voting is still open.
metrics.noPolls: This season has no ballots yet.
metrics.publishedOnly: No individual ballots were recorded for this category. Published winner: {winner} with {count} votes.
metrics.originalEmpty: No votes are stored in the original awards tables.
metrics.originalNote: These are the votes cast on the original awards ballot, before polls replaced it. They are shown exactly as stored.

tracking.title: Where and how people voted
tracking.privacy: Places come from the voter's connection at the moment they voted. The address itself is never stored.

flags.title: Safety flags
flags.intro: A flag is a reason to look, not proof. Review each one: mark it fine, or remove the ballot from the count with a written reason. Every decision is kept.

name.country_mismatch: Profile country differs from where they voted
name.shared_connection: {count} or more ballots from one connection
name.shared_device: {count} or more ballots from one browser
name.new_account: Account under {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} old
name.failed_checks: Failed an eligibility or UID check

detail.connection: {count, plural, one {# ballot} other {# ballots}} on this connection
detail.device: {count, plural, one {# ballot} other {# ballots}} from this browser
detail.age: Account {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} old
detail.failed: {count, plural, one {# failed check} other {# failed checks}}

log.restore: {who} put it back in the count

flags.removeTitle: Remove this ballot from the count?
flags.removeBody: It stops counting in every award on this ballot, and this voter cannot vote again on this poll. Write why: the reason is kept with your name.
flags.reasonPlaceholder: For example: same browser as three other accounts made the same day
flags.failed: That did not work. Try again.

live.title: Garena live link
live.intro: A private page with the live votes per nominee, with the countries and regions they came from, and no voter names. Anyone with the link can open it without signing in, so share it only with Garena.
live.replaceBody: The current link stops working at once. Send Garena the new one.
live.offBody: The page stops opening for anyone who has the link.

done.replace: Link replaced. The old one no longer works.

live.failed: That did not work. Try again.
